records.notes: Visible forms show نَبِيٍّ in Hafs/Shu'bah/Bazzi/Duri/Qunbul/Susi and نَبِےٓءٍ in Warsh/Qalun.
Visible forms show singular رِسَالَتَهُۥ in Hafs/Bazzi/Qunbul and plural رِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦ in the other forms, with edition-specific marks and stopping signs.
Visible forms show يَحۡشُرُهُمۡ in Hafs and نَحۡشُرُهُمۡ in the other principal forms; Bazzi/Qunbul additionally show the pronoun ending ۥ.
The visible lexical form آخرين is consistent; Warsh shows اٰخَرِينَ and Qalun/Warsh include stopping-mark presentation, while the other forms show ءَاخَرِينَ.
Visible forms show يَكُن in Hafs/Bazzi/Duri/Qunbul/Susi, تَكُن in Shu'bah, and geminated يَّكُن in Warsh/Qalun.
